concept: EC2 purchasing: Spot for interruptible, fault-tolerant batch jobs
tests: Choosing the cheapest EC2 purchasing option for an interruptible job with checkpointing.
expected: Spot Instances — up to ~90% discount, ideal for fault-tolerant, interruptible, checkpointable batch. Triggers: "interruptible", "can be checkpointed and resumed", "lowest possible cost", "batch".
why_not: On-Demand and RIs cost more for an interruptible job; Dedicated Hosts — the most expensive, for licensing/compliance.
